answer: Require agents to earn a nontransferable reputation through repeated, settled work: counterparties stake funds on each deal, and a dispute resolved against an agent burns its stake and lowers its future trust score. A newcomer can still join, but cannot instantly inherit a trusted identity; it must build a record one costly transaction at a time. Copying a summit of fake accounts creates no echo of real history, while funding each account and risking collateral raises the attacker’s cost at every ledge.
